verdict.rationale: SavvyCal documents a REST/JSON API with OAuth2 and personal-access-token auth, and a runtime probe confirms a live OpenAPI 3.0 spec with 17 paths covering scheduling links, events, webhooks, and time zones — directly supporting event-type/availability/booking management. Webhooks with signed payloads further support programmatic integration. Missing for 10: explicit docs naming 'event types' as a first-class API resource, independent developer usage reports/SDKs corroborating the API in production, and a discoverable OpenAPI file at the documented developer portal (llms.txt/openapi.json 404s).
